items.q: How many days passed between my visit to the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) and the 'Ancient Civilizations' exhibit at the Metropolitan Museum of Art?
items.gold: 7 days. 8 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
items.pred: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the exact date of your visit to MoMA, so I can’t calculate the number of days between the two trips. If you let me know when you went to MoMA, I’ll be happy to figure it out for you.
